adapterDeposit(address,uint256).details: CORE_ROLE (normal deposit() path, bestEffort=false) or KEEPER_ROLE.

executeRealizeLiquidity(uint256).details: CORE_ROLE (withdraw()'s internal shortfall realization) or KEEPER_ROLE      (the realizeLiquidity() wrapper's own onlyKeeperOrCore gate).

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

recordAdapterFailure(address).details: KEEPER_ROLE only — the sole legitimate caller is the rebalance      plan's withdraw try/catch (executeRebalanceStep(), KEEPER-gated).

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

safeAdapterDeposit(address,uint256).details: CORE_ROLE (deposit/withdraw best-effort redeploy) or KEEPER_ROLE      (harvest/deployIdle/rebalance) — msg.sender is preserved through      the whole delegatecall chain, so this authorizes every legitimate      top-level caller while closing the unauthenticated fallback path.

syncPositionAssets(bool).details: KEEPER_ROLE only — legitimate callers are deployIdle() and      computeInputsForPlan() (reached via prepareRebalance()), both KEEPER-gated.

adapterDeposit(address,uint256).notice: Strict deposit (reverts on failure). Called via delegatecall.

canHarvest().notice: Returns harvest readiness and harvestable sum.

degradedModeActive().notice: DegradedMode: true when system in defensive mode (auto-set by _isDegradedMode check).

executeRealizeLiquidity(uint256).notice: Two-pass pro-rata withdrawal from adapters. Called via delegatecall from vault.

lastRelCapMandateTs(address).notice: Per-adapter timestamp of last rel-cap mandate trigger.

liquidityReadinessBps().notice: Weighted average liquidity readiness across enabled adapters.

rebalancePenaltyBps().notice: Rebalance penalty: higher = capital should not move.

rebalancePlanModule_addr().notice: rebalancePlanModule_addr placeholder (1 slot, EIP-170 refactor reserved)

recordAdapterFailure(address).notice: Record adapter failure with temporal decay. Called via delegatecall.

recordAdapterSuccess(address).notice: Record adapter success (gradual decrement). Called via delegatecall.

recordWithdrawGas(address,uint256).notice: Record withdraw gas for EMA (called by ScoringModule after withdraw)

safeAdapterDeposit(address,uint256).notice: Safe adapter deposit with failure handling + gas EMA recording.

safetyFallbackAdapters(uint256).notice: Ordered list of governance-approved safety venues (priority desc).

settingsModule_addr().notice: settingsModule_addr — StrategySettingsModule (governance setters, last in fallback chain)

syncPositionAssets(bool).notice: Sync positionAssets from live adapter balances. Called via delegatecall.         force=true: bypass cooldown (rebalance). force=false: respect cooldown (deployIdle).

withdrawalLockSeconds().notice: Advisory withdrawal lock in seconds. effectiveWithdrawalLockSeconds() returns this × 7 in degraded mode.
